paper.zh:
## @@title@@

> 作者：@@author@@　单位：@@affiliation@@　日期：@@date@@
> 建议写作顺序：结果 → 方法 → 引言 → 讨论 → 摘要 → 标题。摘要最后写。

---

### 摘要（180–250 词）

**【背景】** 1 句：这个领域为什么重要。
> {Field} has attracted increasing attention because {reason}.

**【目标】** 1 句：本文要回答的那个具体问题。
> This study aims to determine whether {X} affects {Y}.

**【方法】** 1–2 句：数据来源、设备/模型、方法名。
> We {method} on {data}, using {tool} to measure {quantity}.

**【结果】** 2–3 句，必须含数字、方向与对照。
> {Metric} increased from {a} to {b} ({p}%), a {size} improvement over {baseline}.

**【局限】** 1 句（可选）：样本、场景、假设的边界。

**【结论】** 1 句：回答问题并说清意义。
> These findings suggest that {X} is a viable route to {goal}.

**关键词**：@@keywords@@

---

### 1 引言

**Move 1 · 建立研究领域**
1. 宣称中心性：{Topic} is central to {field} because {reason}.
2. 提出经典问题：Prior work has approached {problem} in two main ways: {approach A} and {approach B}.
3. 述评前人研究（按方法分类）：{Author} showed that {finding}.

**Move 2 · 建立研究空白**（四选一，必须能被你的结果填上）
- 指出 gap：However, few studies have examined {X} under {condition}.
- 提出问题：It remains unclear whether {X} generalizes beyond {setting}.
- 反驳前人：These approaches assume {assumption}, which may not hold when {condition}.

**Move 3 · 占据空白**
- 目的/假设：In this study, we test the hypothesis that {X} increases with {Y}.
- 主要发现概述：We therefore set out to determine whether {X} can be predicted from {Y}.

---

### 2 方法（过去时）

**2.1 数据与材料**：来源、规模、筛选标准、伦理审批。
> Data were collected from {source} between {period} and filtered by {criteria}.

**2.2 实验/建模设置**：设备型号、软件版本、环境条件。
> Experiments were performed on {platform} with {specification} at {condition}.

**2.3 分析流程**：按时间顺序，一步一段。
> The procedure consisted of three steps: {A}, {B}, and {C}.

**2.4 评价与统计**：指标定义、对照、显著性水平、重复次数。
> Differences were assessed with {test} at a significance level of α = {alpha}.

---

### 3 结果（过去时，只陈述不解释）

**3.1 总览**：本文用 {method} 在 {data} 上验证 {claim}。

**3.2 【结论式小标题】**
- 问题句：To verify that there are no artifacts…
- 证据：Figure {n} shows that {X} increased with {Y}.（含 n、均值±SD、统计量）
- 结论句：一句话回答本段问题，供下一段引用。

**3.3 【结论式小标题】**（同上结构，一段一个结论）

---

### 4 讨论（现在时）

**4.1 结果总结**　**4.2 可信度威胁**　**4.3 与前人比较**　**4.4 机制或经验**　**4.5 前瞻**
> Several limitations should be noted. First, {limitation}; second, {limitation}.

---

### 5 结论

> This study shows that {claim} under {condition}.
> The findings offer a practical basis for {application}.
> Applying the method to {domain} and validating it at scale are the next steps.

---

### 参考文献

[1] {Author}. {Title}. {Journal}, {Year}, {vol}({issue}): {pages}.

---

### 投稿前自查

- [ ] 标题可以改写成一个「主语+动词+结果」的陈述句
- [ ] 摘要的 Results 里有具体数字
- [ ] 摘要里没有参考文献编号
- [ ] 每个结果段末句是结论，能独立看懂
- [ ] 结果里没有 because / suggests / therefore
- [ ] 讨论里主动写了局限
- [ ] 缩写首次出现给了全称
- [ ] 图题说明结论，图注说明做法
paper.en:
## @@title@@

> Author: @@author@@　Affiliation: @@affiliation@@　Date: @@date@@
> Suggested order: Results → Methods → Introduction → Discussion → Abstract → Title.

---

### Abstract (180–250 words)

**Background** (1 sentence): why this field matters.
> {Field} has attracted increasing attention because {reason}.

**Objective** (1 sentence): the specific question this paper answers.
> This study aims to determine whether {X} affects {Y}.

**Method** (1–2 sentences): data, equipment, method name.
> We {method} on {data}, using {tool} to measure {quantity}.

**Results** (2–3 sentences with numbers and a baseline):
> {Metric} increased from {a} to {b} ({p}%), a {size} improvement over {baseline}.

**Limitations** (optional): scope and assumptions.

**Conclusion** (1 sentence): answer the question and state the significance.
> These findings suggest that {X} is a viable route to {goal}.

**Keywords**: @@keywords@@

---

### 1 Introduction

**Move 1 — Establish the territory**
> {Topic} is central to {field} because {reason}. Prior work has approached {problem} in two main ways: {approach A} and {approach B}.

**Move 2 — Establish a niche** (pick one)
> However, few studies have examined {X} under {condition}. It remains unclear whether {X} generalizes beyond {setting}.

**Move 3 — Occupy the niche**
> In this study, we test the hypothesis that {X} increases with {Y}.

---

### 2 Methods (past tense)

**2.1 Data**
> Data were collected from {source} between {period} and filtered by {criteria}.

**2.2 Setup**
> Experiments were performed on {platform} with {specification} at {condition}.

**2.3 Procedure**
> The procedure consisted of three steps: {A}, {B}, and {C}.

**2.4 Analysis**
> Differences were assessed with {test} at a significance level of α = {alpha}.

---

### 3 Results (past tense, no interpretation)

**3.1 Overview**
**3.2 {Claim-style heading}** — question sentence, evidence with n and SD, then one conclusion sentence.
> Figure {n} shows that {X} increased with {Y}.

---

### 4 Discussion (present tense)

**4.1 Summary**　**4.2 Validity threats**　**4.3 Related work**　**4.4 Lessons learned**　**4.5 Future work**
> Several limitations should be noted. First, {limitation}; second, {limitation}.

---

### 5 Conclusion

> This study shows that {claim} under {condition}.

---

### References

[1] {Author}. {Title}. {Journal}, {Year}.

---

### Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] Title can be rewritten as a claim sentence
- [ ] Abstract Results contain a number
- [ ] No citations in the abstract
- [ ] Every Results paragraph ends with a conclusion sentence
- [ ] No causal words in Results
- [ ] Limitations are stated in Discussion
- [ ] Abbreviations defined at first use

proposal.zh:
## @@title@@

> 项目类型：创新训练项目　负责人：@@author@@　指导教师：@@advisor@@　单位：@@affiliation@@　日期：@@date@@

---

### 一、立项背景与意义

**1.1 选题背景**（问题在校园/行业中的具体表现，最好有数据）
【写】

**1.2 国内外研究现状**（按方法归类，每组结尾落到「在本场景下不够用」）
- 方法 A：{代表工作}，优点 {…}，局限 {…}
- 方法 B：{代表工作}，优点 {…}，局限 {…}

**1.3 研究意义**
- 理论意义：{…}
- 应用价值：{…}

**1.4 团队与前期基础**
- 已修课程 / 已做实验 / 已有数据：{…}
- 导师与平台：{…}

**1.5 参考文献**（近五年为主，格式统一）
[1] …

---

### 二、研究方案

**2.1 研究思路**（问题 → 方案 → 验证，一条主线）
【写】

**2.2 研究内容**（3–5 个模块，每模块一个交付物）

| 模块 | 做什么 | 交付物 | 验收标准 |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | | | |
| M2 | | | |

**2.3 研究方法**（每个模块用什么方法、为什么、备选是什么）
【写】

**2.4 技术路线**（文字 + 流程图，标出关键节点与备选路径）
【写】

---

### 三、创新点

1. 方法创新：与 {对照对象} 相比，{差异}
2. 应用创新：把 {方法} 用于 {场景}
3. 数据创新：构建 {数据集}（若有）

---

### 四、进度安排

| 阶段 | 时间 | 任务 | 产出 | 验收标准 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 一 | 第 1–3 月 | 文献与方案 | 综述 + 方案 | 导师确认 |
| 二 | 第 4–8 月 | 实验/开发 | 数据 + 原型 | 指标达标 |
| 三 | 第 9–11 月 | 验证与写作 | 论文/软著 | 可复现 |
| 四 | 第 12 月 | 结题 | 结题报告 | 验收通过 |

---

### 五、预期成果

- 论文：{篇数、目标档次}
- 软件著作权 / 专利：{件数}
- 样机 / 数据集 / 报告：{…}

---

### 六、经费预算

| 科目 | 用途 | 单价 | 数量 | 金额 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 材料费 | | | | |
| 测试加工费 | | | | |
| 版面费 | | | | |
| 合计 | | | | {总额} |

---

### 七、可行性分析

- 技术可行性：{…}
- 条件可行性：{平台、设备、数据}
- 时间可行性：{课程压力与排期}

---

### 自查

- [ ] 项目名称能一句话验收
- [ ] 研究内容每块都有交付物与验收标准
- [ ] 创新点每条都有对照对象
- [ ] 进度表每阶段有验收标准
- [ ] 预算总额与分项对得上
